    "reading": "A clattering tribe; the sound of a noisy, theatrical mob.",

    "source": "Littré, Dictionnaire de la langue française (1872)",

    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Ba + ta + clan; 'ba' (sheep sound) + 'ta' (thanks in Italian) + 'clan' (family group)",

    "languages": ["en", "it", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Ba-ta-clan ~ 'battaclan' (French) ~ 'bataklan' (Turkish: 'batak' = swamp, 'lan' = suffix)",
    "reading": "A swampy gathering; a murky, tangled assembly of voices.",
    "languages": ["fr", "tr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Ba-ta-clan → 'can't a lab'? → 'tabla can' → 'clan at ba'",

    "languages": ["en", "hi"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "B.T.C. — from Hebrew initials: Beth (house), Teth (serpent), Kaph (palm) — house of the coiled serpent",
    "reading": "A dwelling of hidden wisdom; the serpent's nest as a place of initiation.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "B (2nd letter, beta = house) + A (1st, alpha = ox) + T (20th, tau = cross) + A (1st) + C (3rd, gamma = camel) + L (12th, lamed = goad) + A (1st) + N (14th, nun = fish)",
    "reading": "House, ox, cross, camel, goad, fish — a journey of burden and transformation.",
    "languages": ["en", "he", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "B=2, A=1, T=20, A=1, C=3, L=12, A=1, N=14 → sum = 54; 5+4=9 (completion, initiation)",
    "reading": "The number nine: the end of a cycle, the threshold of a new mystery.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Ba- (from Greek 'baino' = to go) + ta (from Sanskrit 'tat' = that) + clan (from Gaelic 'clann' = offspring)",
    "reading": "Going toward that offspring — a movement toward a destined lineage.",
    "languages": ["grc", "sa", "ga"],
    "source": "Liddell & Scott, Monier-Williams, MacBain's Gaelic Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.2
  }
